name: Johan Varghese K
description: We are incredibly proud of our 2nd-year CS student for co-authoring a research paper in the prestigious Journal of Systems Architecture (JSA). The paper explores metaheuristic approaches for co-scheduling tasks on shared bus-based heterogeneous platforms.

name: Navaneeth V Sankar
description: We are pleased to share that Navaneeth V Sankar has published his research titled "A Reinforcement Learning Approach to Contention-Aware Co-Scheduling in Heterogeneous Cyber-Physical Systems."

name: Sreehari Vinayan
description: The CS Association is proud to congratulate Sreehari Vinayan (CSE ’28) on being selected as a winner of Code for Good (CFG), the flagship hackathon conducted by JPMorgan Chase at Bangalore!
